UPDATE teaching_depart_day_log SET
unit_open_count = COALESCE(unit_open_count, 0) + 1 course_work_assign_count = COALESCE(course_work_assign_count, 0) + 1 additional_work_assign_count = COALESCE(additional_work_assign_count, 0) + 1 course_work_submit_count = COALESCE(course_work_submit_count, 0) + 1 additional_work_submit_count = COALESCE(additional_work_submit_count, 0) + 1 course_work_correct_count = COALESCE(course_work_correct_count, 0) + 1 additional_work_correct_count = COALESCE(additional_work_correct_count, 0) + 1 id = id
WHERE id = #{id} AND depart_id = #{departId} AND create_time = #{day} AND #{counter,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IN ( 'UNIT_OPEN_COUNT', 'COURSE_WORK_ASSIGN_COUNT', 'ADDITIONAL_WORK_ASSIGN_COUNT', 'COURSE_WORK_SUBMIT_COUNT', 'ADDITIONAL_WORK_SUBMIT_COUNT', 'COURSE_WORK_CORRECT_COUNT', 'ADDITIONAL_WORK_CORRECT_COUNT' )
